notes:
CRM notes:
- Account: Pinegrove builds product analytics features (real-time insights, conversational discovery) inside their SaaS. Mid-market ARR, expanding AI features.
- Journey so far: started on Redwood hosted_api (embedding index for search, chat assistant for help center). Devs liked SDK ergonomics and streaming. Finance flagged egress/per-token cost variability.
- Why Dedicated POC: want predictable throughput for MLP (in-app chat) and lower unit cost at scale; data isolation + VPC are musts.
- POC goals (concrete): 1) Meet latency SLO: chat 95th < 150ms (token generation path), 2) Sustained throughput: 100-150 RPS for short-chat workloads, 3) Validate canary rollout & rollback flow with traffic ramp from 1% -> 50% -> 100%, 4) Verify fallback routing between model variants and between regions (us-east1 <-> us-west1 -> eu-west1), 5) Measure cost per 1k tokens and expected savings vs hosted.
- Canary + routing plan (engineer notes):
  * Canary cohorts: start with quantized, cost-optimized model variant for 1% traffic; metrics: latency, 5xx rate, perplexity/regression on 20 prompt set.
  * Rollout gates: automated metric checks at each step (latency increase >10% OR regression >2% -> auto rollback).
  * Fallbacks: primary model = redwood-llm-v2-quant (fast), fallback model = redwood-llm-v2-pt (higher quality). Region failover plan: prefer same-region pool, on capacity/excess latency trigger failover to nearest region; exercise during POC with synthetic load.
  * KV/prefix caching: enable prefix cache for common help-center queries to hit cache and reduce cost; measure cache hit-rate threshold (target > 60%).
  * Batching settings: start with small batching (dynamic) to keep latency; test larger batch sizes in canary stage for throughput tradeoffs.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) required, KMS integration mandatory for key management; retention controls to meet customer data residency (EU for EU customers). Redwood to provide SOC2 docs and contract language.
- Stakeholders: Product: Elena Park (owner of chat roadmap), Infra/Platform: Rajiv Mehta (responsible for VPC), Finance: Tom Morris (budget approver), Legal: Karen Liu (NDA & contract).
- Quotes from calls: "We need predictable monthly spend and a simple rollback if model quality degrades." — Elena Park.
- Logistics & next steps: finalize NDA, Redwood to deliver Dedicated POC SOW and canary runbook by 2026-03-15. Pinegrove to provision VPC peering info and security contacts. After successful POC, expect Dedicated reserved commit conversation (12–24 month).
- Risks: procurement timeline (budget cycle ends 2026-05), integration complexity for KMS, potential latency variance across EU region for heavy prompt lengths.
- Action items (short):
  1) Redwood: send SOW + canary runbook (owner Maya).
  2) Pinegrove: complete security questionnaire, share VPC CIDR and peering window (owner Rajiv).
  3) Schedule POC kick-off (target week of 2026-03-22).
